Return and Refund Policy

Thank you for shopping with Shop Cardboard Boxes. We aim to provide quality packaging solutions, but if you’re not completely satisfied with your purchase, please review the policy below.

Returns

We accept returns for both defective and non-defective products under the following conditions:

  • Items must be unused, new, and returned in their original packaging.

  • You must submit a return request within 10 days of receiving your order.

  • Returns are accepted by mail only. In-person or drop-off returns are not supported.

  • A return label will be included in your package.

  • We do not charge a restocking fee.

To start a return, email info@shopcardboardboxes.com with your order number and reason for return. If there’s visible damage or a defect, please include photos.

Exchanges

Exchanges are accepted within the same 10-day window, provided the item is in new condition. A replacement will be shipped once the original product is returned and inspected.

Refunds

Once your return is approved and received:

  • Refunds will be processed within 10 business days.

  • Funds will be returned to your original payment method.

  • All refunds are processed in USD (U.S. Dollars).

Non-Returnable Items

We do not accept returns for:

  • Items returned after the 10-day period

Quick answers before you order

Frequently Asked Questions

Find sizing, strength, and ordering details in one place. If you still need help, you can shop standard boxes or request a quote for custom requirements.

What cardboard box sizes are available? We offer a range of standard sizes suitable for shipping, storage, and moving. If you need a specific size, request a quote and share your dimensions and quantity.
What is the difference between cardboard and corrugated boxes? Corrugated boxes typically include a fluted layer between linerboards, improving strength for shipping and stacking. Cardboard may be used as a general term, but corrugated is the common choice for transit protection.
Can I order boxes in bulk? Yes. Bulk orders are available for businesses and frequent shippers. For larger quantities, request a quote so we can match the best option for your box type and requirements.
Do you offer custom box sizes? Yes. If standard sizes do not fit your products, we can help with custom sizing. Share the internal dimensions and intended use case when requesting a quote.
Which box strength should I choose for shipping? It depends on product weight, fragility, and transit distance. For heavier or fragile items, stronger corrugated options help reduce crush risk. If unsure, request a quote and share what you’re packing.
Do you provide custom printing on boxes? Custom printing is available for branded packaging. Request a quote and include your logo/artwork details, print areas, and quantity so we can guide you on the best print approach.
Are your cardboard boxes recyclable? Most cardboard and corrugated boxes are recyclable. Keeping boxes clean and dry improves recycling acceptance. If you need guidance for a specific use case, we can help.
How do I measure a box correctly? Use internal dimensions and measure in the order: length × width × height. Include space for inserts or padding when shipping fragile products.
Can I use these boxes for moving and storage? Yes. Many customers use corrugated boxes for moving and storage. For stacking or heavier items, stronger box options can help reduce bending and collapse over time.
How do I get help choosing the right boxes? If you know your product size and weight, start with standard boxes in the shop. For custom requirements or bulk orders, request a quote and share your details.

Corrugated Cardboard Packaging

The packaging material known as corrugated cardboard serves as an effective solution to execute design and marketing concepts.

Modern product packaging now depends on corrugated cardboard which evolved from its original role as a basic packaging material. The product offers companies a perfect solution because it combines practicality with environmental sustainability and attractive design. The following discussion investigates the factors which led to corrugated cardboard becoming a standard packaging material and identifies the essential design components used in packaging solutions.

Features of Corrugated Cardboard

The main material used for shipping and consumer packaging purposes is corrugated cardboard. The unique design structure of this packaging system allows it to support heavy loads which makes it appropriate for moving various products.

Common Uses of Corrugated Packaging

For example:

  1. Food products

  2. Electronics and household appliances

  3. Clothing and accessories

  4. Auto parts

  5. Construction products

  6. Household chemicals, cosmetics, etc.

The sales design development process benefits from corrugated cardboard flexibility because it enables designers to test different shapes and thickness levels and structural arrangements which results in basic boxes and advanced design solutions.

In addition, corrugated cardboard is valued for several other features.

Environmental Friendliness as a Competitive Advantage

The growing demand for sustainable packaging solutions has made corrugated cardboard the preferred choice because it offers various advantageous properties.

  • The material breaks down into its original components through biological processes after it enters water or soil environments.

  • Recycling: Cardboard containers are easily recycled and can be reused.

  • Brands now use corrugated cardboard to replace plastic products which helps them decrease their environmental footprint.

Companies that use corrugated cardboard packaging boxes show their environmental social responsibility which draws customers who care about sustainability.

Aesthetics and Personalization Options

Modern technologies for processing corrugated cardboard allow you to turn it into a tool for creating exclusive designs using the following methods:

  • Printing: The material allows for simple application of colored images and logos and slogans to its surface.
    The packaging design serves two purposes because it helps customers identify the product while building trust between customers and the brand.

  • Die-cutting: Cardboard sheets are easy to cut, allowing you to create custom shapes, inserts, and additional elements.

  • Tactility: The natural texture of corrugated cardboard packaging adds a special warmth and charm, which is especially appreciated in the premium segments.

Practicality and Protection of Goods

Thanks to its corrugated structure, corrugated cardboard provides a high degree of protection for its contents.

✔ Ribbed design absorbs impacts
✔ Different material grades provide suitable dimensions
✔ Air cushion supports temperature control

The presence of an air cushion also helps avoid sudden temperature changes and maintain the temperature of the contents for a certain period of time.

The combination of functional design with attractive appearance makes corrugated board essential for businesses that seek to achieve both style and operational efficiency.

Variability of Application

Modern technologies make it possible to use corrugated cardboard not only for the production of boxes, but also for the production of:

  • Advertising displays, life-size figures, stands, booths, showcases, and other POS materials for stores

  • Creative packaging including boxes with pull-out elements and multi-level structures and other designs

  • Packaging solutions for high-end items needing sustainability and great appearance

Conclusion

The packaging material known as corrugated cardboard serves as an effective solution to execute design and marketing concepts. The eco-friendly properties of this material together with its ability to work with multiple materials and design customization options allow brands to create distinctive packaging solutions which draw customers while protecting their products and demonstrating their commitment to environmental sustainability.

Why Small Cardboard Boxes Are Essential for E-commerce Success

Online retailers are under ever increasing pressure to reduce their shipping costs, minimize their environmental footprint and to ensure that their products arrive safely and in prime condition. However, the choices that are made regarding packaging are far reaching and are not limited to simply protecting the product. The packaging of a product can affect its margin, the satisfaction of the customer, and the overall efficiency of a business. Using small cardboard boxes can help to alleviate these pressures and has a number of benefits, such as reducing waste and cost, and providing a premium unboxing experience. A premium unboxing experience not only increases customer satisfaction but also encourages repeat business and reviews.

The Economics of Right-Sized Packaging

Dimensional weight pricing from most of the carriers has change the way we have to package products for shipping. There are a multitude of factors that go into packaging economics in e-commerce. A small increase in the size of a package relative to the weight of the product inside can have a huge effect on the cost to ship the product. The weight of a package is not always the rate that the carrier will charge. In almost every case the dimensional weight, length x width x height divided by the dimensional factor for that carrier, will be the rate that the carrier charges. This can cause the carrier to charge a lot more for an over-sized box than a smaller one. So using the smallest boxes possible to ship products can be a cost effective way to reduce shipping costs. Many online retailers do not realize the cost savings that can be achieved by switching to the use of appropriate small shipping boxes from the traditional large shipping tubes. Reducing dimensional weight pricing, reducing the amount of void fill needed, increasing the number of products that can be shipped on a single pallet and increasing the capacity of the warehouse are all possible.

Quantifying Small Box Savings

Cost Factor Large Box Small Box Savings
Dimensional Weight Charge £8.50 £5.25 38% reduction
Void Fill Material £0.45 £0.10 78% reduction
Storage Space (per 1000 units) 45 cubic metres 18 cubic metres 60% reduction
Damage Rate 3.2% 1.1% 66% reduction
Large package volume discounts can be realized by making modest improvements in package dimensions. However, these improvements can have a compounding effect on shipping costs for large volumes of small products. Upgrading to small box optimization can reduce shipping costs by 15 to 25 percent.

Electronics and Tech Accessories

Mobile phone cases, charging cables, earbuds and other tech accessories are one of the most popular e-commerce products.   • Professional presentation reflecting tech product quality

Food and Confectionery

Artisan food producers, specialty confectioners and gourmet snack companies occasionally send samples of their products to stores, markets, and potential buyers. They require a food safe packaging solution that will adequately protect the product while allowing them to meet all food safety and sanitation requirements. In addition, the packaging should look attractive to the end user. Small food boxes provide a solution to a number of special needs including:

Environmental Impact and Sustainability

According to a new study by Vistaprint, 73% of online shoppers say that packaging sustainability is an important factor in shopping frequency and recommending a brand to others. Material Efficiency Benefits:

Use less packaging and smaller packaging materials such as smaller boxes. If you do not need to fill a large quantity of packaging material to make a shipment of a product then using a smaller box can help to reduce packaging material waste. Reducing packaging material waste benefits the environment, the consumer and helps to lower material costs and landfill waste. Together with reducing pack materials we can also increase the transport efficiency of our small boxes which will contribute to a greater overall environment benefit. With more products in each truck run our small pack is contributing to less fuel used per package and less emissions. This greater transport efficiency with our small packs, is also a means for you as a company to achieve your sustainability targets, while at the same time reducing the cost per package.

Customer Experience and Unboxing Psychology

Unboxing is one of the most important moments in the ecommerce customer journey. It impacts customer satisfaction, the number of reviews left and even the frequency of repurchases. Packing Speed Optimization

A faster packing team is a happier customer. With a small box system, you can quickly determine which boxes to use, spend less time with void fill, and reduce the number of quality control checks that need to be done as compared to using large, generic "oblong" boxes. Small, standard size small boxes make training easier and during busy holiday seasons when speed of fulfillment is crucial to sales, seasonal staff can be quickly and effectively trained to accurately process orders.

International Shipping Considerations

Cross border e-commerce has made international trade more complicated and small shipments can be beneficial in reducing customs and duty charges as well as being compliant with international carrier standards. Compact packages clear customs more quickly, which results in faster shipping and a better customer experience. Smaller declared values are often below duty, but it is still important to use the correct customs documentation for all shipments. International dimensional weight pricing is charging you more for large and bulky packaging and small affordable packaging is required to remain competitive in an ever increasing global marketplace. Many of our customers are expanding into the world of international e-commerce and quickly realize that the savings from using our premium custom cardboard boxes can be offset with lower international shipping rates.

Implementation Strategy for E-commerce Businesses

Switching to an optimized small box system requires a different set of strategies concerning inventory investment, vendor relationships and internal processes. Implementation Steps:
  1. Audit current products measuring dimensions and identifying small box candidates
  2. Calculate shipping costs comparing current packaging versus small box alternatives
  3. Test prototypes validating protection and presentation with actual products

Achieving measurable ROI in these products will then set a strong precedent to roll out small box packaging to other products within your product portfolio. It's also important to remember that supplier partnerships are important. <style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  :root {
    --gold:     #d9af5d;
    --gold-lt:  #e8c97a;
    --gold-dk:  #b8923e;
    --dark:     #2a272c;
    --dark-lt:  #3d3940;
    --light:    #f0f0f0;
    --light-dk: #dcdcdc;
    --white:    #ffffff;
    --text:     #2a272c;
    --muted:    #5a5560;
    --r:        8px;
  }
  body { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; background: var(--light); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.68; }
  a { color: var(--gold-dk); text-decoration: none; transition: color .15s; }

  .wrap { max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 24px; }

    padding: 84px 0 72px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; contain: layout paint;
  }
  .hero::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; top: -120px; right: -80px;
    width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%;

    pointer-events: none;

  .hero-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    background: rgba(217,175,93,0.13); border: 1px solid rgba(217,175,93,0.28);

    letter-spacing: 1.9px; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 6px 17px; border-radius: 30px; margin-bottom: 22px;
  }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(30px, 4.8vw, 54px); font-weight: 900; color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.10; margin-bottom: 20px; max-width: 740px;
  }
  .hero h1 span { color: var(--gold); }
  .hero-intro {
    font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);

  .hero-btns { display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn-primary {
    display: inline-block; background: var(--gold); color: var(--dark);
    font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: var(--r);
    border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s, transform .18s, box-shadow .18s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--gold-lt); color: var(--dark); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(217,175,93,0.28); }
  .btn-ghost {
    display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: var(--white);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700;
    padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: var(--r); transition: border-color .18s, color .18s;
  }
  .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--gold); color: var(--gold); }
  .hero-meta {
    margin-top: 50px; padding-top: 28px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(217,175,93,0.16);
    display: flex; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .meta-num { font-size: 27px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--gold); line-height: 1; }
  .meta-lbl { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.50); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .8px; margin-top: 4px; }
  /* TRUST */
  .trust { background: var(--white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-dk); padding: 15px 0; }
  .trust-row { display: flex; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  .trust-item { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  /* SECTIONS */
  .sec { padding: 68px 0; }
  .bg-white  { background: var(--white); }
  .bg-light  { background: var(--light); }
  .bg-dark   { background: var(--dark); }
  .bg-gold   { background: var(--gold); }
  .kicker { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold-dk); margin-bottom: 9px; }
  .kicker-lt { color: var(--gold); }
  h2 { font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 35px); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.18; margin-bottom: 12px; color: var(--dark); }
  .on-dark { color: var(--white); }
  .on-gold { color: var(--dark); }
  .lead { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.74; max-width: 580px; margin-bottom: 36px; }
  .lead-dk { color: rgba(240,240,240,0.58); }
  .lead-gd { color: rgba(42,39,44,0.70); }
  /* FEATURED PRODUCTS — only 4 */
  .prod-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4,1fr); gap: 18px; }
  @media(max-width:900px){ .prod-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); } }
  @media(max-width:580px){ .prod-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2,1fr); } }
  .prod-card {
    border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
    border: 2px solid transparent; background: var(--light-dk);
    transition: border-color .22s, transform .22s, box-shadow .22s;
  }

  .prod-card img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1/1; object-fit: cover; }
  .prod-name { padding: 11px 14px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); background: var(--white); text-align: center; line-height: 1.35; }
  /* MAIN CONTENT LAYOUT */
  .content-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px; gap: 52px; align-items: start; }
  @media(max-width:900px){ .content-wrap { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  /* PROSE */
  .prose h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); margin: 38px 0 11px; }
  .prose h3:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .prose p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.86; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .prose p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .prose ul { margin: 6px 0 18px 18px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.88; }
  .prose li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .prose li::marker { color: var(--gold-dk); }
  .prose strong { color: var(--dark); font-weight: 700; }
  /* Natural inline links — underlined, gold */
  .prose a {
    color: var(--gold-dk); font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-color: rgba(184,146,62,0.38);
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    transition: color .15s, text-decoration-color .15s;
  }
  .prose a:hover { color: var(--gold); text-decoration-color: var(--gold); }
  /* SPECS TABLE */
  .spec-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 12px; border-radius: var(--r); overflow: hidden; }

  .spec-table td { padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-dk); color: var(--muted); vertical-align: top; }

  .spec-table tr:nth-child(even) td { background: rgba(240,240,240,0.50); }
  .spec-table td:first-child { font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark); width: 32%; }
  /* SIDEBAR */
  .sidebar { background: var(--dark); border-radius: 14px; padding: 30px; position: sticky; top: 24px; }
  .sidebar h3 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .contact-row { display: flex; gap: 11px; align-items: flex-start; margin-bottom: 15px; padding-bottom: 15px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); }
  .contact-row:last-of-type { border-bottom: none; margin-bottom: 0; }
  .c-ico { font-size: 17px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }
  .c-detail { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(240,240,240,0.48); line-height: 1.5; }
  .c-detail strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: var(--light); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 1px; }
  .c-detail a { color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; }
  .c-detail a:hover { color: var(--gold-lt); }
  .f-divider { border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); margin: 18px 0; }
  .f-kicker { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; display: block; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .fi {
    width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(217,175,93,0.20);
    border-radius: var(--r); font-size: 14px; color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    transition: border-color .18s; font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .fi:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
  .fi::placeholder { color: rgba(240,240,240,0.28); }
  textarea.fi { resize: vertical; min-height: 78px; }
  .f-btn {
    width: 100%; background: var(--gold); color: var(--dark); font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 15px; padding: 13px; border-radius: var(--r); border: none;
    cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s, transform .18s; margin-top: 4px; font-family: inherit;
  }
  .f-btn:hover { background: var(--gold-lt); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .f-note { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(240,240,240,0.32); text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .f-ok { display: none; background: rgba(217,175,93,0.11); border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: var(--r); padding: 18px; text-align: center; color: var(--gold); font-weight: 700; margin-top: 14px; font-size: 14px; }
  /* WHY CARDS */
  .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3,1fr); gap: 18px; }
  @media(max-width:760px){ .why-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
  @media(max-width:460px){ .why-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .why-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(217,175,93,0.12);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 26px 20px;
    transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s;
  }
  .why-card:hover { background: rgba(217,175,93,0.07); border-color: rgba(217,175,93,0.30); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .why-ico { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .why-card h3 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .why-card p { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(240,240,240,0.56); line-height: 1.65; }
  /* FAQ */
  .faq-list { max-width: 800px; }
  .faq-item { border: 1.5px solid var(--light-dk); border-radius: var(--r); margin-bottom: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
  .faq-q {
    padding: 15px 19px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--dark);
    cursor: pointer; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    background: var(--light); transition: background .18s; user-select: none; gap: 14px;
  }
  .faq-q:hover { background: var(--light-dk); }
  .faq-ico { font-size: 13px; color: var(--gold-dk); flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform .26s; }
  .faq-q.open { background: var(--dark); color: var(--white); }
  .faq-q.open .faq-ico { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--gold); }
  .faq-a { display: none; padding: 13px 19px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.80; background: var(--white); }
  .faq-a.open { display: block; }
  .faq-a a { color: var(--gold-dk); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(184,146,62,0.34); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
  .faq-a a:hover { color: var(--gold); }
  /* CTA */
  .cta-box { text-align: center; }
  .cta-box h2 { color: var(--dark); }
  .cta-box p { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(42,39,44,0.68); max-width: 460px; margin: 0 auto 28px; }
  .cta-btns { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn-dark { display: inline-block; background: var(--dark); color: var(--white); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; padding: 13px 30px; border-radius: var(--r); transition: background .18s, transform .18s; }
  .btn-dark:hover { background: var(--dark-lt); color: var(--white); transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-ring { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: var(--dark); border: 2px solid var(--dark); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: var(--r); transition: background .18s; }
  .btn-ring:hover { background: rgba(42,39,44,0.08); color: var(--dark); }
  @media(max-width:640px){
    .hero { padding: 54px 0 46px; }
    .hero-meta { gap: 22px; }
    .trust-row { gap: 14px; }
    .spec-table td, .spec-table th { padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; }
  }
</style>
